Ember Step

Pyromancer feature, 2nd level

As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is within 5 feet of a fire. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

Kindled Path

From 6th level, the fire you leave follows you:

  • The space you left holds dim light until the start of your next turn.
  • A creature that enters that space takes 1d4 fire damage.
